body: From the DM-172 review (orchestrator): `projectRunTiming` (src/core/services/timing.ts) has no caller yet; you wire it in. `actorKeyOf` treats a handle-less span as a separate actor for each attempt, so an orchestrator reporting without a handle is counted twice (60m of overhead in a 30m run). Have the host feed always send actor handles, or key handle-less orchestrator spans by role. Sprint `time` follows plan membership while effort and wall clock follow the sprint active at claim; label them so consumers are not misled.
